# E0335: a _coalesce is not _coalesce(source path, fallback)

coalesce takes two arguments: a reference into the source instance, and the
fallback to use when the referenced field is absent.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a?: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		b: _coalesce(prev.a)
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0335]: _coalesce takes two arguments: _coalesce(prev.<path>, fallback)
 --> history/1.0.thema:7:6
  |
7 |         b: _coalesce(prev.a)
  |            ^^^^^^^^^
  |

error[E0347]: v0.0 declares a and v1.0 does not, and nothing maps it
 --> history/1.0.thema:5:1
  |
5 | ForwardLens: (prev): {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: write <field>: prev.a to move it, or a: _drop
```
